title: Hunts FH-042T: Decide whether the claim command refuses a second fork branch, and race two branches against real Postgres

source.ref: Split from FH-042S (2026-11-18): the player form and the challenges authoring shipped dark; the database halves move here.

detail: Owed after FH-042S. (1) Owner decision, recorded as an ADR if taken: whether hunt_claim_apply itself should refuse a second member of a choice group, which would close the staff-approval gap named in FH-042 (today the evaluator closes the other branches and the progress-count check under the run lock refuses the second claim). A yes needs a migration through the serial database gate. (2) A pgTAP test, or a recorded live two-session run, of two branches of one fork claimed at once against real Postgres, which the FH-042 tests only model. (3) Operator: a creator publishes a fork and a Mystery from a phone and a player answers it on a phone. Done when: the two-branch race is recorded against the real database and the owner's ruling on (1) is the rule the claim command enforces. Requires: FH-042S. Owner role: Game systems, with the database owner. Hunts switches stay OFF.
